title: Attrition and censoring reconstruction
description: Reproduce and freeze the 98-variant attrition classification: 84 fitted, 11 right-censored ([Mg2+]1/2 > 40 mM or unstable/unphysical fit), 2 closing-pair abnormal-reactivity, 1 alternate-structure/unknown-pattern. The 11 right-censored enter censored likelihood (not deleted). The 2+1 structural-QC variants retain per-row reasons and enter predefined sensitivity analysis. The 84 complete cases are not called an unbiased 98-variant validation set. Compare fitted, censored, and structural-QC strata by mutation class, sequence distance, and reference dG. Report condition-level and analysis-level attrition.

q1_registry.description: 99 variants from Q1 (1 reference + 98 mutants); all 98 mutants have titration data

right_censored_11.description: Published 11-variant exclude list. All enter censored likelihood (NOT deleted). Sub-classified by censoring reason.

GCUGAA_CAUGC.reason: [Mg2+]1/2 > 40 mM (1017.40); beyond tested range; closing-pair mutant CG1GC

CCUCAC_CACGG.reason: [Mg2+]1/2 > 40 mM (4412.29); beyond tested range; a_0=1.41 unphysical

GCUCAA_CAUGC.reason: [Mg2+]1/2 > 40 mM (5.39e19); degenerate fit; a_0=2.14, n=2.28 unphysical; closing-pair mutant CG1GC

CUUAAC_UAUGG.reason: Unstable fit: n=0.185 (extremely low cooperativity), a_0=0.354 (very low baseline); mg_1_2 not reliably measurable

CCUACA_UACGG.reason: Unphysical fit: a_0=0.526 (very low baseline, below typical 0.7-1.0 range); mg_1_2 not reliably measurable

UCUAAA_CAUGA.reason: Unstable fit: n=0.634 (low cooperativity), mg_1_2_err=3.14 > mg_1_2; closing-pair mutant CG1UA

CCUCAC_UAUGG.reason: Unphysical fit: a_0=1.014 > 1 (exceeds theoretical maximum baseline); mg_1_2 not reliably measurable

CCUGAA_CAUGG.reason: Unphysical fit: a_0=1.002 > 1 (exceeds theoretical maximum); mg_1_2=35.33 near censoring boundary

closing_pair_abnormal_2.description: Closing-pair mutants (bp1 mutation) with abnormal titration behavior. Identified from 13 non-excluded closing-pair mutants by statistical outlier analysis of Hill fit parameters.

GCUAAA_UACGC.reason: Degenerate Hill coefficient: n=4.93 with err=16.16 (error 3.3x value). n is 3.2x the median (1.22) and 1.6x the next highest non-excluded variant. Fit is numerically unstable despite mg_1_2 in tested range. Closing-pair mutation CG->GC.

GCUUAA_CAUGC.reason: Abnormally low baseline DMS reactivity: a_0=0.609 (lowest among 13 non-excluded closing-pair mutants, 2.7 sigma below median 0.88). Suggests partial pre-folding or alternate conformational state at 0 Mg. Closing-pair mutation CG->GC.

closing_pair_abnormal_2.identification_method: Among 13 non-excluded closing-pair (bp1) mutants, computed distribution of n, a_0, mg_1_2_err/mg_1_2. GCUAAA_UACGC is n outlier (4.93 vs median 1.22, IQR 1.11-1.53). GCUUAA_CAUGC is a_0 outlier (0.609 vs median 0.90, IQR 0.84-0.95). Both exceed 1.5xIQR fence.

alternate_structure_1.description: Non-closing-pair variant with combined abnormal fit parameters suggesting alternate RNA structure.

CCUAAG_CACGG.reason: Combined abnormality: n=3.03 (highest among 74 non-excluded non-closing-pair variants; 2.5x median 1.22, n_err/n=1.98 indicates unstable cooperativity) AND a_0=0.582 (2nd lowest; 2.7 sigma below median 0.88). This unique combination of high Hill coefficient + low baseline suggests the variant adopts an alternate conformational state. Mutations U6C and U8C (0-indexed) are in the tetraloop/receptor region, potentially destabilizing the native fold.

alternate_structure_1.identification_method: Among 74 non-excluded non-closing-pair variants, computed joint distribution of (n, a_0). CCUAAG_CACGG is the only variant that is simultaneously a top-5 outlier in BOTH n (highest: 3.03) and a_0 (2nd lowest: 0.582). No other variant shows this combined abnormality pattern.

fitted_84.description: 84 variants with reliable Hill-equation fits within the tested Mg range. NOT called an unbiased 98-variant validation set.
fitted_84.includes_note: 2 variants (CCUACG_AAUGG mg_1_2=90.87, UCUAAG_AAUGG mg_1_2=440.88) have mg_1_2 > 40 but are NOT in the published 11 exclude list. Their fits are stable (reasonable n, a_0) so they remain in the fitted set per published analysis. Their mg_1_2 values are beyond the tested range and are flagged for sensitivity analysis.
